items.claim: Seek or play after a hash `t` never reaches the URL, because the new hold's listener runs after `toUrl`
items.note: While fixing it I found that the new hold's first seek also reached `toUrl` before `hold` was set. That wrote the clamped time over a `t` the span couldn't reach yet. This commit fixes that too: it unsubscribes `toUrl` while the hold is made and subscribes it again after. Tests: "writes the next scrub after a hash t to the URL" and "writes play to the URL while a hash t still waits for the span".

items.claim: A hash `t` that matches the shown time, or has no `t`, leaves the earlier waiting hold alive
items.note: `fromUrl` now releases the old hold before its early return. Test: "drops a waiting t once the hash names the time shown, or none", which adds a `Growing` fixture story.
